videos.headline: Johnson makes dazzling 1-handed TD snag for Cowboys
videos.description: Taylor Cornelius' pass to Tyron Johnson gets hauled in with one hand to complete a spectacular 7-yard Oklahoma State touchdown.

videos.headline: Referee gets rocked on Oklahoma State TD
videos.description: Oklahoma State receives an unintended block from a referee, as Dillion Stoner sees daylight en route to a 30-yard touchdown strike from Taylor Cornelius.

videos.headline: Lock threads needle to Gicinto for Missouri TD
videos.description: Missouri QB Drew Lock whips a pass to Dominic Gicinto in the corner of the end zone for a 5-yard touchdown.

videos.headline: Lock's throw reeled in with one hand by Blanton
videos.description: Missouri's Drew Lock lofts a ball to Kendall Blanton, who slides and snags a 16-yard touchdown with one hand to put Missouri back up 2.

videos.headline: Oklahoma State's Cornelius tosses 3rd TD pass
videos.description: Oklahoma State QB Taylor Cornelius rolls right and zips a 9-yard touchdown to Tylan Wallace in the back of the end zone.

videos.headline: Hubbard gets to the edge on Cowboys TD
videos.description: Oklahoma State cashes in on Missouri's turnover as Chuba Hubbard takes the handoff and bursts to the end zone for a 4-yard touchdown.

videos.headline: Cowboys' Johnson hauls in Cornelius' 4th TD pass
videos.description: Taylor Cornelius is on the move and heaves a 46-yard dime to Tyron Johnson for the touchdown, their second scoring connection of the game.

videos.headline: Lock drops dime to Johnson for long Missouri TD
videos.description: Drew Lock hits Johnathon Johnson in stride for an 86-yard touchdown, narrowing Oklahoma State's lead to 9.

videos.headline: Cowboys' Siverand ejected for targeting on big hit
videos.description: Dominic Gicinto receives a Drew Lock pass and is blown up by Kemah Siverand, who is ejected for targeting on the vicious hit.

videos.headline: Missouri's Rountree motors to house on 55-yard TD
videos.description: Missouri RB Larry Rountree III takes the pitch and weaves through traffic en route to a 55-yard touchdown to pull within 2 of the Cowboys.

videos.headline: Lock stopped short on 4th-and-1 to seal Cowboys' victory
videos.description: With just over a minute to play, Drew Lock attempts to run for the first down on 4th-and-1 and is stopped short by the Oklahoma State defense.
